bio: Claudia Di Vivo was born in 1722 and died in 1811. She is recorded among the forebears of Maria d'Ambrosio but is not an ancestor of John. Her parents are unknown; the Di Vivo surname is found at Guardia.

researchNotes: Tree: Claudia Di Vivo (1722-1811). The tree duplicates Angelo A. Gialanella + Maddalena Parisi as her parents too - an error that would make her Claudio's sister, and her Di Vivo surname contradicts a Gialanella father. Remove.
